ambient_events: Somebody comes out, checks both ways along the street, and goes back in.
The door buzzer goes off for a long five seconds and nobody answers it.
A window on the first floor opens, a cigarette is smoked entirely, and the window closes.
description: A rooming house in a converted terrace, three doorways knocked into one and a hand-painted board over the middle of them reading REST ASSURED — NIGHTLY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, with the monthly rate painted out and redone twice. A card in the glass says NO SMOKING IN BEDS above a second card, older, saying NO SMOKING IN BEDS PLEASE.
name: Rest Assured
